actual_boundary: Per-result formatter selection through actual DefaultOutputFormatterSelector and AcceptHeaderParser, plus prepared public owner calls; no serialization/network/startup claim.
proposal_scope: Parameterless, nonwildcard, nonempty ordinal-identical first supported value can avoid both parsers only when the requested segment ends at its buffer end. Preserve original segment-overread behavior, else/loop/fallback and post-CanWriteType collection state. No parsed collection cache and no F072 metadata change.
requirements: Preserve validation and virtual type-check order, including real CanWriteType mutation/clearing of the public SupportedMediaTypes collection.
Preserve null/default content type, unsupported types, raw configured reference/offset selection, live first/later matches and ordering.
Preserve legal public StringSegment boundary behavior: the existing token lexer may inspect a nondelimited buffer tail beyond segment Length. Raw segment equality alone is not sufficient.
Preserve parameter errors, invalid earlier entries, unreachable invalid later entries, wildcard server/client distinction, case-insensitive and suffix fallback.
Exercise actual header/declared-content-type production through the public default selector; inspect input segment offsets/flags and material formatter/content-type selection.
Keep GetSupportedContentTypes, API/default/convention, package/configuration and all existing lines unchanged.
Original/proposed focused and existing formatter/selector tests must pass each row; owning hosted content-negotiation cases preserve status/headers/body.
Use identical source-linked canonical harness/settings/non-owner dependencies and immutable actual owner/PDB identities.
At most three serialized measured comparisons; keep all costs, controls, instability and allocation outcomes; publish evidence before a justified fork-only draft.
known_limitations: Default selector microbenchmark does not time controller discovery, DI, serialization, HTTP/network or full request latency.
Original tests establish existing behavior; new preservation tests are not a functional-red bug fix.
Production Accept/configuration distribution and universal improvement are not established.
